metadata.study_title: Phase 22 H1 Gate 2 Resolution Research Study
governance_locks: Zero mutations to src/core/** and Genesis onboarding profile.
Architecture Gate remains STRICTLY LOCKED; Protocol v1.5 is NOT AUTHORIZED.
Directional/component metrics are strictly DIAGNOSTIC MEASUREMENTS, not architectural replacements for canonical S.
Candidate 6 is explicitly designated as a PREDICTION-RESIDUAL DIAGNOSTIC, conceptually distinct from simple displacement.
RQ3 is a predefined empirical gate evaluation against quantitative thresholds, not an inferential statistical test.

table_d_candidate_diagnostics.name: Scalar Euclidean Magnitude
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.strengths: Invariant with production Active Inference; computationally trivial O(1); isotropic distance metric.
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.weaknesses: Isotropic metric blindness; collapses orthogonal affective states into near-identical scalar distances; prone to headroom squeeze under common-mode density.

table_d_candidate_diagnostics.name: Component-wise Displacement
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.formulation: [Delta P, Delta A, Delta D] = p_T - p_0
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.role_classification: potentially suitable for future architecture research
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.strengths: Fully uncouples orthogonal affective axes; reveals massive Medium-High separation in Pleasure (Cohen's d ~ -3.5 to -4.0) and Arousal (Cohen's d ~ +2.5 to +3.5); immune to isotropic collapse.
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.weaknesses: Multi-dimensional output requires vector-valued downstream conditioning or multi-criterion evaluation.
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.status_verdict: potentially suitable for future architecture research

table_d_candidate_diagnostics.name: Directional Projection
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.role_classification: potentially suitable for future architecture research
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.strengths: Produces scalar metric aligned with specific affective trajectories; maintains high separation along tier-specific reference vectors (v_M, v_H).
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.weaknesses: Requires locked empirical reference vector v_ref defined a priori; projection value depends on reference axis choice.
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.status_verdict: potentially suitable for future architecture research

table_d_candidate_diagnostics.name: Angular Separation
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.formulation: theta(Delta p, v_ref) = arccos((Delta p . v_ref) / (||Delta p|| ||v_ref||))
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.strengths: Measures pure directional divergence independently of magnitude; stably distinguishes Medium from High (angle ~ 48-63 deg).
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.weaknesses: Singular/undefined when ||Delta p|| -> 0; insensitive to absolute stimulus intensity or cognitive urgency.

table_d_candidate_diagnostics.name: Mahalanobis Displacement
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.role_classification: potentially suitable for future architecture research
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.strengths: Accounts for empirical covariance and variance differences across PAD axes; normalizes common-mode Dominance variance.
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.weaknesses: Requires estimating and inverting 3x3 covariance matrix Sigma; sensitive to ill-conditioned covariance if resting variance is near zero.
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.status_verdict: potentially suitable for future architecture research

table_d_candidate_diagnostics.name: Vector-Valued PAD Surprise (Prediction-Residual Diagnostic)
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.role_classification: potentially suitable for future architecture research
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.strengths: Directly grounded in Active Inference generative prediction-error theory; preserves full directional information of prediction failure.
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.weaknesses: Conceptually a prediction residual (differing from simple displacement); requires explicit transition generative model (A, b); higher dimensional.
table_d_candidate_diagnostics.status_verdict: potentially suitable for future architecture research

rq3_evaluation.scoped_verdict: Current dual Gate 2 thresholds are not simultaneously achieved for T <= 25 under the frozen G1 stimulus set and current scalar S measurement.
